results.title: Same Guy
results.overview: Five Guys had his heart. Michael Jackson had his feet.

results.title: Dream vol 2. «A strolling seagull»
results.overview: Part II of the "Dream" duology. He opens a book and falls asleep. What he sees is not a nightmare. It's a walk to the sea. Two seagulls. And feelings they never had before.

results.title: Dream. Vol 1: «apple evil eye»
results.overview: A guy comes home. Sits on the couch. Picks up his phone. And falls asleep. What he sees in his dream isn't a dream. It's what he let inside himself while scrolling.

results.title: Terri & Richard
results.overview: In 1960s New York City, Terri Thal was a manager of folk musicians, including Bob Dylan, while Richard Kostelanetz was a pioneer in the literary avant-garde. Now, sixty years later, they've met online and fallen in love.

results.title: Jenny
results.overview: Jenny, a young software professional from a coastal village in Kerala, returns home to spend a few days with her family before leaving for work. When a renovation forces her estranged grandfather back into her life, long-buried memories begin to resurface.

results.title: The Fading of Morning Light
results.overview: As a father reminisces about his late daughter, her ghost appears to remind him that the seeds of her favourite flower have sprouted, and today is the day he must set out to plant them.

results.title: Monster of The Sea Guard
results.overview: Stranded and unconscious at sea, then waking up from her fainting and not knowing the cause, a woman (26) has to escape from a masked human figure who feels frightening to her.

results.title: Running Snake
results.overview: Desire, shame, and loneliness from a young woman’s perspective.

results.title: Yesterday afternoon, Mei went to do abortion
results.original_title: Yesterday afternoon, Mei went to do abortion
results.overview: Yesterday afternoon，Mei went to do abortion. The appearance of a sorceress planted a seed of terror in her heart.

results.title: The Collector
results.overview: Someone experiences the weirdest hair appointment in their life.

results.title: Друзья детства
results.overview: Dasha is flying to another country, but just before her departure, she stops by to say goodbye to her childhood friend Fedya, who is transforming an abandoned factory into escape rooms. While touring the deserted spaces, Dasha reminisces about her childhood and risks missing her flight.

results.title: Discovery
results.overview: Will recruits his friend Aaron to film the greatest discovery in the history of human kind.

results.title: Azul
results.overview: Blue ceases to be merely a color and becomes a persistent presence—an everyday reality that takes hold each day; it carries a weight, a meaning, and a past that still dwells within it.

results.title: If I Could, I'd Kill Nostalgia
results.original_title: Si pudiese, mataría a la nostalgia
results.overview: While the city remains taciturn and unmoved by those who traverse it, Felipe and Marta navigate it as best they can, slowly learning to inhabit this space far from home. Amidst the overwhelming nostalgia of a cold, fast-paced, and bustling San José, a disruption in their daily routine forces them to confront what they carry with them and what they are willing to cherish.

results.title: The Paths of Maria
results.overview: Maria-Esther is a Black Cuban woman and a Santería practitioner on the verge of emigrating to Brazil due to the economic crisis gripping her country. In the final days before her departure—uncertain about her future and facing her sister's religious intolerance—she decides to turn to Oxum to reveal her destiny.

results.title: Cockroach
results.overview: During a doctor's visit, two siblings debate how to handle the care their mother needs. Their respective personal circumstances lead them to make a decision that reveals their true nature.
A young photographer travels by bus. Along the way, encounters with various people lead her to rethink not only how she portrays them but also the way she relates to them.
